summary.en: Israel's first dedicated video-game incubator, launched April 2022 in Jerusalem's historic Old Shaare Zedek building. A non-profit run by Dani Bacon, established with the Jerusalem & Heritage Ministry, Jerusalem Development Authority, Bezalel Academy, Hebrew University, ironSource and the Social Space Association. Its first cycle (~3 months) ended with five indie game projects; accepted teams receive a grant (reported up to NIS 80,000), workspace and mentorship.

summary.en: Tel Aviv pre-seed accelerator founded 2017 by Guy Katsovich and Yair Vardi (ex-Unit 8200). Invests $150K for 7.5% via a 10-week bootcamp across Tel Aviv, Silicon Valley, NY and LA; <20 slots from 1,200+ annual applicants. 140+ startups funded with combined valuation $3B+; backed by Insight Partners and raised a $20M pre-seed fund. Gaming credentials include InnPlay Labs (acquired by Playtika for ~$300M).
